title: write!(f, "error: {}", msg) should use write!(f, "error: {msg}")
description: smtp/config.rs ConfigError::fmt and reader/config.rs ConfigError::fmt both use the legacy format-string style: write!(f, "I/O error: {}", msg), write!(f, "parse error: {}", msg), write!(f, "validation error: {}", msg). Since Rust 2021 edition (which this codebase uses) the captured-identifier syntax write!(f, "I/O error: {msg}") is idiomatic, shorter, and what clippy::uninlined_format_args flags. All six write! calls in the two Display impls should use the captured form.
